an3.107:1.1: This is obviously a teaching on monastic conduct. Renunciates are expected to maintain a dignified demeanor at all times. | Singing the Dhamma is criticized at [an5.209](), and disallowed for mendicants at [pli-tv-kd15:3.2.3](); see too [pli-tv-kd22:1.10.4]().
an3.107:1.2: Dancing, singing, and music were strongly associated with sex workers ([pli-tv-kd8:1.1.7]()) or general distraction ([dn31:10.2]()).
